observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a white plastic cube tank (IBC - Intermediate Bulk Container) inside a grey metal cage frame, with a blue plastic outlet valve at the bottom front.
Photo 1 shows a red/white hazard-style sticker and a barcode label on the tank shoulder, text not legible.
Photo 2 is a close-up of embossed markings on the tank wall showing partial numbers '...1000' and '250 LTR ...' - likely manufacturing/capacity markings, but not fully readable.
Surface of the plastic shows dirt/staining consistent with prior use; metal cage shows some discoloration/light surface rust.
No interior view, no leak test, no photo of the tank filled with liquid or draining from the valve.
No brand or manufacturer name is legible in any photo.

identity.kind: 1000L IBC plastic tank (caged) for liquid storage
read_from: photo 2 embossed markings (partially legible, capacity unclear)

claims.claim: To store industrial liquids or hazardous chemicals
claims.evidence: No certification, chemical-compatibility label, or integrity test is visible in any photo; red sticker in photo 1 is present but text is unreadable.
Photo 2 shows embossed numbers that could read '1000' but are too worn/cropped to confirm exact capacity.

risks.risk: Tank could have hairline cracks, prior chemical residue, or odour contamination affecting safe reuse for liquids.
risks.proof: Clear photo of tank interior (looking down the top opening) and close-up of the full body for cracks/stains.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a used/worn tank of unverified food/chemical safety, not as a certified-clean unit

risks.risk: Bottom valve may be damaged, stuck, or leaking.
risks.proof: Short video of the valve being opened and closed, or a clip of water flowing through it.
risks.if_unproven: priced as valve condition unknown, i.e. worst case (non-functional)

risks.risk: Metal cage may be rusted through or weakened, affecting structural support when filled.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all four cage corners and the base feet.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cage in only fair condition, not full strength

risks.risk: Exact capacity (could be 1000L or smaller, e.g., 250L as partially read in photo 2) is unclear, which changes value significantly.
risks.proof: A clear, unobstructed photo of the full embossed capacity plate or manufacturer plate.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lower end consistent with a standard 1000L IBC in used condition, since larger capacity cannot be confirmed

proof_requests: Clear photo of the full manufacturer/capacity plate (unobstructed by cage bars or watermark).
Video of the valve opening/closing and liquid flow.
Photo looking into the top opening to check interior cleanliness/cracks.
Close-up of all four cage corners and base for rust or damage.
Photo or note of what the tank previously stored (chemical residue risk).
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used 1000L-style IBC tank in a metal cage; capacity and condition claims are unverified so it must be priced at the worst-case (standard used condition, unconfirmed capacity/valve/cage integrity) against the single available comparable of the same type.
